improving maize production in the semi-arids of eastern Kenya through integrated nutrient management and water harvesting options.
the effect of integrated nutrient management and water harvesting techniques in the southern rangleands of Kenya.

the development of sustainable and environmentally friendly technologies for improving the performance of rainfed maize production in the southern rangleands of Kenya, and the mitigation of drought effects in the region.
